items.title: 21.7 Cosmic redshift: evidence (saboot) for an expanding universe (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of cosmic redshift (PDF 175-176).

blocks.text: Cosmic redshift woh effect (asar) hai jis mein universe ki door ki galaxies se aane wali roshni spectrum ke laal (red) sire ki taraf stretch ho jati hai (khinch jati hai). Yeh is liye hota hai ke universe expand ho raha hai (phail raha hai) aur galaxies ham se door ja rahi hain. Is ka nateeja yeh hai ke galaxies se nikalne wali roshni ki wavelength barh jati hai. Galaxy jitni door ho, us ka redshift utna zyada hota hai, yani woh utni tezi se door ja rahi hai. Cosmic redshift study kar ke scientists maloom karte hain ke universe kitni tezi se phail raha hai.
Roshni ki wavelength mein napi gayi tabdeeli source (roshni dene wala) aur observer (dekhne wala) ke darmiyan relative velocity (aik doosre ke hisaab se velocity) se seedhi juri hai:

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab equation (21.4) ko 'Z = Δℓ/ℓ >> Δf/f >> v/c' chhapti hai. '>>' ka matlab 'bohat zyada bara' hai, jo yahan ghalat hai: teeno ratios (nisbatein) taqreeban barabar hain, jaisa upar wali line mein ≈ ke saath likha hai, aur ℓ ki jagah λ (wavelength) hona chahiye. Yeh formula tab theek hai jab v roshni ki speed c se bohat kam ho. (Redshift mein frequency ghatti hai, is liye Δf ka sign ulta hai; size barabar hai.)

Jab wavelength ki tabdeeli Δλ positive (musbat) ho to yeh redshift (Z) hai: celestial object (aasmani cheez) zameen se door ja raha hai. Agar Δλ negative (manfi) ho to yeh blue shift hai: object zameen ki taraf aa raha hai. Astronomers stars aur galaxies ki roshni ke rang ki tabdeeli dekh kar samajhte hain ke woh kitni tezi se aur kis direction mein chal rahe hain. Door ki galaxies ki roshni expected (jitni umeed thi) se zyada laal nazar aati hai (redshift). Yeh is liye hai ke universe phailne ke saath khud space stretch ho rahi hai, jo roshni ki waves ko bhi khainch kar un ki wavelength lambi kar deti hai. Redshift har direction mein nazar aata hai, jo universe ke phailne ki nishani hai. Baat sirf yeh nahi ke galaxies space mein aik doosre se door ja rahi hain, balke un ke darmiyan ki space hi barh rahi hai. Yeh findings (nataij) Big Bang theory ko mazboot support karti hain, jis ke mutabiq universe aik bohat garam aur dense halat se shuru hua aur tab se barh raha hai. Redshift aur faasle ke relation se scientists universe ka size aur waqt ke saath us ki tabdeeli maloom karte hain.

blocks.title: Solved example (hal shuda misal, izafi)
blocks.problem: Laboratory mein 656.3 nm wavelength wali hydrogen line aik galaxy ke spectrum mein 662.9 nm par nazar aati hai. Galaxy ki door jane ki velocity maloom karein.
steps: Δλ = 662.9 nm − 656.3 nm = 6.6 nm (positive, yani redshift)
blocks.answer: v = 3.0 × 10⁶ m s⁻¹, galaxy door ja rahi hai.

blocks.prompt: Kisi star ki spectral line laboratory wali wavelength se chhoti wavelength par nazar aati hai. Yeh kya batata hai?
blocks.explanation: Δλ negative hai, yani blue shift: star hamari taraf aa raha hai.

items: Redshift: Z = Δλ/λ ≈ v/c (21.4), jab v, c se bohat kam ho.
Δλ positive: door ja raha (redshift); negative: qareeb aa raha (blue shift).
Har direction mein redshift: space phail rahi hai; Big Bang ka support.
